entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who collects agents; the column says self-serving planeswalkers like him answer a summons only if it benefits them.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Benevolent planeswalker who may answer a call simply because someone is in need.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who is now known as Sarkhan the Mad, cited as one of Bolas's collected relationships.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who is now Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane now under Phyrexian control, which planeswalkers must visit and observe to conclude it is no longer Mirrodin.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders whose ascendancy over Mirrodin is evident to visiting planeswalkers.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native inhabitants of Mirrodin, who no longer are in charge of the plane.

events.summary: Bolas's long-term collecting of relationships is cited: Sarkhan Vol became Sarkhan the Mad and Tezzeret the Seeker became Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.
events.quote: Tezzeret the Seeker is now Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas

events.summary: Mirrodin has come under new management as Phyrexia takes over, and visiting planeswalkers must conclude for themselves that the Mirrans have lost the plane.
events.quote: There are too many examples of Phyrexian ascendancy to pretend that the Mirrans are in charge now.

relations.note: Now known as Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.
relations.quote: Tezzeret the Seeker is now Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas
